note: Shared by Values ('What makes Black Lake different') and Investors ('Why partner with Black Lake Capital?'). Items 1-3 are the approved differentiators; item 4 condenses the live 'Lean Team Advantage' and 'Tech Industry Focus' columns into the approved value point. Draft copy.

items.title: Your people. Your playbook.
items.body: Your leadership team stays in place and your operating expertise stays at the center. We respect the vision you built, keep the existing staff, and bring no predetermined playbook.

items.title: Shared success.
items.body: You sell a portion of your company and retain meaningful ownership, creating the potential for a "second bite of the apple." On average, founders have taken about {secondTransactionMultiple} more cash in the second transaction than the first.

items.title: Experience without ego.
items.body: A track record that speaks without being the loudest voice in the room: {transactions} technology transactions and {cashOnCash} cash-on-cash realized returns on equity invested.

items.title: The deal should fit the business.
items.body: A lean team and a deep focus on technology businesses let us make decisions quickly and shape each deal around the needs of the company, not the other way around.
